description: An orange bowl sits on a red bedspread with a small white-and-blue animal toy behind it and a pink rubber duck near the bowl’s base, along with a few small blocks and yellow plastic pieces off to the right. The right hand reaches forward toward the white-and-blue toy, grasps it as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it down toward the bowl, then lowers it into the bowl and releases it so it rests inside while the hand withdraws.
